statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Where were you when people moved toward the back?

statements.speaker: IMANI
statements.text: Near the lobby corridor. I heard a man shouting for us to move.

statements.speaker: IMANI
statements.text: About six or seven. I cannot swear to the number.

statements.speaker: IMANI
statements.text: Before I reached the back doorway, I heard the alarm.

statements.speaker: OFFICER
statements.text: Did you see the woman assist?

statements.speaker: IMANI
statements.text: I saw her inside, but I did not see her give orders.
